title: Valar Atomics media placeholder
description: The stand-in for a reactor video or plant photo: a soft diagonal fade between the muted surface and the page colour, or a flat muted surface. It fills whatever slot it is given.
notes: purely decorative (aria-hidden); used inside `dark` scopes it reads as dark film, swap it for an img or video of the same size
name: valaratomics-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: film: a dark diagonal fade (near the page colour) · photo: a mid-grey fade for pictures with detail · flat: a flat muted surface

props.name: className
props.description: size and position of the slot it fills
